caption:
Your invoice already exists in a chat, a notebook and a receipt. You retype it for the PDF.

Collect 6 fields once — who, what, how many, how much, when, paid or not — and the second copy writes itself.

Comment STACK and I'll send the 6-field checklist plus the 3-step flow. No new software needed.
cta: ManyChat: STACK → Invoice-Flow-Checklist.pdf (verify delivery before posting)
